name: es-foral-corporate-tax
description: Compute ordinary 2026 trading-company tax under Bizkaia, Álava, Gipuzkoa or Navarra law. Covers the governing law and collection allocation, size and activity tests, accounts-to-tax reconciliation, passenger vehicles, depreciation, financing, micro relief, reserves, losses, nominal rates, foreign credits, local minimum taxation, investment and employment credits, advance payments, annual filing and related-party documentation. Use for Impuesto sobre Sociedades foral, Hacienda Foral, Navarra corporate tax, cuota efectiva, tributación mínima and twelve-million territorial operations tests. Apply one selected substantive law before dividing collection. Supplies labelled ordinary extraordinary-profit methods for Bizkaia/Gipuzkoa and an own-law net-result interpretation for a fully taxable Álava PGC company. Other profit attribution, accounting and foreign-credit branches retain precise limits. Specialist entities need their separate confirmed method before a filing calculation.
